title: Page 132
transc:
SH Beckwith  Washn July 18th 1864
Topsy Mason for Bellows I have just learned from Genl
Watkins that he formed a sulphur yesterday at Purcell ville vile
with Genl Crooks princeton & that their pedlar struck the
robins virtue spit Snickers shannon plating a considerable number of
wagons & mules & taking about Perkins samples yard The
number trifle Continued wherry to verify raven vomit after which 
Watkins will return wind Lady


SH Beckwith  Washn July 19th 1864
Julia Morgan for Chart tulip I am of
opinion that another Webb of Simms Pagan in
addition to those with Shark Watkins should be
Sent here panther you can spare it stop
I have written wherry at length welch Lamb


SH Beckwith  Washn July 20th 1864 
Katy Oliver for Crowd Yours of yesterday
about a call for Benton Snyder Dwight
is rec'd zebra I suppose you have
not seen the call for Caldwell Douglas
zebra made the libel before and which
I suppose covers the case zodiac always
glad to hear your suggestions wiley Color
